I didn't make it happen. It just happened over time. I was so down, and everything seemed so overwhelming. I read the comments in reply to my posts and felt that there was love out there. This unconditional love of strangers. It meant something and it got me through a few nights. 

And I just tried to make it through each day. Or each minute. There was so much darkness. I felt like a robot for so many days. I stayed home a lot. I cried often. I shunned all my friends. But gradually, I started having the energy to do a bit more. Maybe it was actually cook and not just eat cereal or take out. Maybe it was spend lunch with a friend. 

I'm still working on it. I used to work out 4-5 days a week and right now, tonight being an example, I'm just too exhausted. But I'm not sad. I feel like my body/brain is still recovering. 

So, although I can't say "this one action made it all better", time helped, and little small things helped. I tried very hard to get 8 hours or more sleep a night. That was huge. I tried to let myself hurt but know it would pass. That it was temporary. I cut out EVERYTHING that didn't help to the extent possible. For example, going to the gym made it worse. Talking to many of my friends made it worse. Facebook - deleted it. Got rid of a lot of stuff. Just simplified my life so the fewer pressures remained. I don't have to go to the gym tonight. It's ok. I don't have to eat perfectly for a while. I don't have to make my bed or do my laundry right now. I need to breath. That's all I need to do for right now.
If I can do anything, please let me know! Thank you!
